# Browser Use Box

Browser Use Box is a 24/7 Claude Code agent setup for a Linux VPS or other box. It combines a Telegram bot, a persistent Browser Use Cloud browser session, and local systemd services so a user can text an agent from anywhere and let it work with a real browser.

Repository: https://github.com/browser-use/bux
Public site: https://browser-use.github.io/bux/

## What Bux Provides

- Claude Code logged in and always available.
- Telegram control through a private bot.
- A persistent Chromium session via Browser Use Cloud and `browser-harness`.
- Live login handoff when a site requires 2FA, CAPTCHA, or manual login.
- Scheduled checks and long-running goal work on a user-owned Linux box.

## Install

Install from a blank Ubuntu box:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/browser-use/bux/main/install.sh | sudo BROWSER_USE_API_KEY=bu_xxx bash
```

Full docs: https://github.com/browser-use/bux/blob/main/install.md

## Managed Pilot Offer

Bux also has a managed pilot for teams that already use Telegram for sales, support, partner onboarding, or operations.

Pilot page: https://browser-use.github.io/bux/pilot.html

Offer:

- $1,000/month.
- One scoped private Telegram AI operator workflow.
- Launched in 7 days.
- Telegram first.
- Optional browser, Gmail, Calendar, GitHub, Slack, Sheets, or CRM handoff depending on the job.
- Human handoff and weekly tuning included.

Good workflows:

- Qualify Telegram inbound before a human responds.
- Summarize partner or support requests into a clean handoff.
- Check web, GitHub, CI, or status pages and report only what matters.
- Schedule follow-up checks so leads or operational tasks do not disappear.

The pilot is not meant to replace judgment or create an unsupervised sales bot. It is for repetitive first-line handling, context collection, and cleaner human handoff.

## Agency Implementation Page

Agency page: https://browser-use.github.io/bux/telegram-ai-operator-agencies.html

This page is for AI automation agencies that need a managed implementation path for client projects involving Telegram-heavy sales, support, onboarding, or operations. It positions Bux as the always-on delivery layer for one scoped client workflow while the agency keeps the client relationship.

Best-fit agency projects have existing Telegram message volume, a repeated first-line workflow, clear handoff owners, and tools the operator can check. Poor fits include cold-message spam, generic chatbot demos, and workflows that require irreversible agent decisions without human review.

## Partner Pilot For Agencies

Partner page: https://browser-use.github.io/bux/managed-pilot-partners.html

This is for AI automation agencies with Telegram-heavy client workflows. Bux can act as the managed runtime and delivery layer for one client workflow while the agency remains client-facing.

Best-fit partner projects have existing message volume and operational pain. Bad fits include generic chatbot demos, unsolicited broadcast bots, or workflows that require irreversible agent decisions without human review.
